text.p: DAOU Systems Inc on Wednesday said it has won two contracts totaling $745,000 to manage a computer network for Mercy Health Services in Iowa.
Mercy Health Services is one of the nation's 10 largest health care organizations, and its computer network links over 75 facilities, 690 physicians and 68,000 in-patients annually.

Under the terms of the contract, DAOU will provide Mercy Health Services with a staff of network engineers located at the company's new office in Des Moines, Iowa. The contract also provides Mercy Health Services with a single-point of contact for managing hardware and software vendors.
